started.credentials: Existing gh authentication read in memory only; not retained or printed.

sanitized_error: Attempt stopped on an exception; exception message intentionally not retained.
limitations: One exact object only; no retries, alternate repository, credential output, install, Git mutation or catalog replacement.
Original batch/action response is not retained because it may contain signed download credentials; only its hash, length and allowlisted metadata are recorded.
Recovered bytes, if available, remain in this handoff pending root decision. JSONL/schema validation does not certify freshness, ownership release eligibility, answer safety or legal currentness.
